problem: The Agent bar root was horizontal but the managed live and ended lists remained vertical, so additional managed Agents increased the bottom bar height.
fix: Pass orientation to ManagedAgents at construction; use horizontal live/ended lists in AgentBar and vertical lists in Sidebar.

regression.check: A second live Agent must not increase the horizontal bar height; the vertical list must grow.

The user GUI and installed binaries were not restarted or replaced.
